title: TLS cert expiry mtime heuristic gives wrong values for non-generated certs
description: tls.rs:83-88: when the .expiry sidecar file is missing, cert expiry is estimated from file mtime assuming exactly 365 days validity from write time. A cert restored from backup, copied from another host, or with different validity period produces a wildly wrong expiry estimate. The sidecar file path is incorrect (.expiry replaces .crt extension → kith.expiry not kith.crt.expiry). The fallback should log a warning and return a sentinel value indicating unknown, not manufacture a false estimate.
